title: Negation cue lists
description: clinical-content/rules/negation-cues.json: the cue lists of the negation-aware text matcher (NegEx-style). A shared clinical rule file read by the web (lib/triage-engine/src/negation.ts) and iOS (NegationMatcher.swift through SharedClinicalContent); the rule itself stays twinned. Every word is lower case (the matcher lower-cases the text; a right single quote is read as an apostrophe). Registered as negation-cues.

preCues.description: Pre-negation cue -> the number of words allowed between the cue and the term.

negatingContractions.description: Contractions that negate with a window of 5 words (deliberately not can't / couldn't / won't: "can't swallow" is a complaint).

pseudoAfter.description: Cue -> words that, directly after it, make it a pseudo-negation ("no change", "not improving").

pseudoAfterVerbNegation.description: After "not", "never" or a negating contraction: a double negative or a hedge ("hasn't stopped bleeding").

verbNegationFillers.description: Words allowed between a verb negation and a double-negative verb ("has not yet settled").

scopeTerminators.description: Words that end a negation scope: a new assertion starts.

scopeContinuers.description: Words that continue a negation scope without counting towards the window.

notFollowers.description: "not X" after a term: "rebound not elicited".

copulas.description: Words skipped (not counted) between a term and a post-cue.

fusedNegatives.description: Whole words that negate a root found inside them ("afebrile", "nontender").

hyphenFree.description: "pain-free": the term's word followed by a hyphen and one of these.

maxPreWindow.description: Upper bound on the words scanned back from a term for a pre-negation cue.
